title: Expose global counters to CEL end-condition evaluator
description: check_end_conditions calls _build_end_condition_variables which does not include session.runtime.counters in the CEL variable context. Games like Pig that use global counters for player totals (alice_total, bob_total) cannot use check_end_conditions to evaluate win conditions like 'alice_total >= 100'. Fix: merge session.runtime.counters into the variables dict in _build_end_condition_variables in python/baize/end_conditions.py.
close_reason: Counters were already injected at end_conditions.py:82-83 and cel.rs:70-72. Updated Pig test to use check_end_conditions() instead of manual CEL workaround.
